crossRefs.note: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing…
For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

translations.web: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
translations.bsb: So I admired the dead, who had already died, above the living, who are still alive.
translations.kjv: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
translations.asv: Wherefore I praised the dead that have been long dead more than the living that are yet alive;
